chunks: But if they become haughty (then remember) that those who are close to your Lord sing His praises night and day and do not grow weary of (doing so).
ai.seo_question: Who are the ones that glorify Allah night and day without weariness?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the perpetual, tireless glorification (tasbih) of the angels and prophets, serving as a model for the faithful who emulate their humility against divine arrogance. It underscores the concept of continuous worship (dahr) as a spiritual state of nearness to Allah, contrasting the static pride of the rejectors with the dynamic, unceasing devotion of the elect.
